newsitem.title: CHINA: China Foods says in talks to sell asset.
newsitem.headline: China Foods says in talks to sell asset.

text.p: China Foods Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks to sell a property asset but no decision had been made of the disposal.
"Discussions are taking place between the company and a property consultant to explore the possibility of disposing the company's interest in East Asia Gardens," the company said in a statement.
"However, no definite decision has been made by the board to proceed with such disposal or on the timing and terms thereof," it said.
China Foods hold a majority interest in East Asia Gardens, a shopping arcade in Tsuen Wan in Hong Kong's New Territories.
Shares of the property investment and food processing group surged HK$0.50 or 15.38 percent to HK$3.75 at midday.
